title: GuardianBox sandboxlet: safe local runbook task execution and replay
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: our current runbooks-as-tasks tooling runs fixes directly in production or in fragile ad-hoc sandboxes. That increases blast radius for junior responders and slows investigation because runs are not easily replayable. Goal: deliver a lightweight developer-friendly 'sandboxlet' called GuardianBox that can execute curated runbook tasklets locally or in a permissioned ephemeral environment, capture inputs/outputs/telemetry, and provide idempotent replay and postmortem artifacts. Scope: 1) sandboxlet runtime shim for typed tasklets, 2) prefix/KV snapshotting to capture model and cache state where relevant, 3) telemetry tripwires and automated rollback hooks, 4) local replay CLI + UI integration in Ops Console, 5) guarded exec policy with RBAC and mandatory audit logging. Out of scope: full migration of every existing runbook to typed tasklets (will be iterative), and complex cross-account network remediations (handled by privileged workflows). Constraints: must not require cluster changes for initial MVP; must integrate with existing Admin credential proxy; must produce machine-readable artifacts for postmortems.
acceptance_criteria: Sandboxlet can run a curated tasklet against a recorded snapshot and produce identical outputs in replay mode
Exec policy enforces RBAC and records an audit entry in the central audit log for every run
CLI supports dry-run, execute, and replay modes and exits with stable, documented exit codes
Telemetry dashboard surfaces run counts, mean time-to-fix for sandbox runs, and a high-severity tripwire when a sandboxed run attempts a privileged action
Canary release to two teams (SRE and Support Triage) without infra-side changes and no customer incidents during 7-day canary
technical_decisions: Use lightweight WASM-based sandboxlet for language isolation to reduce platform dependency surface
Record minimal KV-prefix snapshots (configurable per tasklet) to keep artifact sizes under 5MB by default
Enforce a signed manifest for approved tasklets; unsigned tasklets run in read-only dry-run mode
Telemetry tripwire emits an event to Ops Console and triggers automated rollback policy when a run attempts a protected mutation
Credential use is proxied via existing admin-proxy service to avoid embedding secrets in sandboxlets
